## What this dashboard shows

- Dashboard tracks accounts receivable performance across Wipro Enterprises business units (Consumer Care & Lighting, Infrastructure Engineering, Joint Ventures) from multiple ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA systems A & B, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Tally Prime).
- All headline metrics currently show zero: ₹0 Total Open AR, 0 days DSO, 0.0% CEI, 0.0x AR Turnover, ₹0 Overdue Amount, and 0.0% Bad Debt Risk.
- The dashboard measures how quickly customers pay (DSO), collection effectiveness (CEI), aging of unpaid invoices, and cash collection expectations.

## What to report

- Total open receivables stand at ₹0 with zero overdue amount, resulting in 0.0% bad debt risk (below the 0.5% low-risk threshold).
- Days Sales Outstanding is 0 days, well below the best-in-class benchmark of <30 days and the 30–50 day average range.
- Collection Effectiveness Index is 0.0%, significantly below the 80% standard target and 90% top performer threshold.
- AR Turnover is 0.0x, translating to approximately 0 day cycle time.

## Watch out for

- **Data completeness issue**: All panels display "No data available" or zero values; the dashboard is not populating with actual receivables data despite showing multiple source systems in scope.
- **Demo/synthetic data caveat**: The page explicitly states "Demo data: accounts receivable is synthetic (company codes 1000/2100/5000) because SAP BDC masks real customer IDs" – these are not real operational figures.
- **CEI below target flag**: The 0.0% Collection Effectiveness Index is tagged as "Below target (<80%)", confirming poor or absent collection performance measurement.
- **Question to ask**: Why is no receivables data flowing from the listed ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA A & B, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, Tally Prime), and when will real customer data replace the synthetic demo set?
